title_en: Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Comprehensively Strengthening Judicial Protection for Ecological Civilization Construction and Green Development in the Yangtze River Basin
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Comprehensively Strengthening Judicial Protection for Ecological Civilization Construction and Green Development in the Yangtze River Basin

Fa Fa [2017] No. 30

To thoroughly implement the guiding principles of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, under the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, to promote the comprehensive implementation of the 13th Five-Year Plan and the Outline of the Plan for the Development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt, to fully leverage the functional role of environmental resource adjudication, and to provide robust judicial services and protection for ecological civilization construction and green development in the Yangtze River Basin, the following opinions are hereby put forward regarding comprehensively strengthening environmental resource adjudication work in the Yangtze River Basin.

I. Fully Recognize the Significant Importance of Comprehensively Strengthening Judicial Protection for Ecological Civilization Construction and Green Development in the Yangtze River Basin

1. Comprehensively strengthening environmental resource adjudication work in the Yangtze River Basin is an important judicial safeguard for implementing the Outline of the Plan for the Development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt and realizing the national strategy for the development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt. The Yangtze River Economic Belt development strategy is a major decision and deployment made by the Party Central Committee to proactively adapt to, grasp, and lead the new normal of economic development, scientifically plan China's new economic landscape, and benefit both the present and the future. It has significant practical significance and far-reaching historical importance for coordinating the Five-Sphere Integrated Plan, promoting the Four-Pronged Comprehensive Strategy, and realizing the Chinese Dream of the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. People's courts at all levels must fully recognize the importance of providing judicial protection for ecological civilization construction and green development in the Yangtze River Basin, follow the approach of "ecological priority, basin interaction, intensive development", vigorously leverage the functional role of environmental resource adjudication, and promote the construction of a golden economic belt with a more beautiful environment, smoother transportation, more coordinated economy, more unified market, and more scientific mechanisms.

2. Comprehensively strengthening environmental resource adjudication work in the Yangtze River Basin is an inherent requirement for implementing General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech on promoting the development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt. The Yangtze River is the lifeblood of the Chinese nation and an important support for the development of the Chinese nation. General Secretary Xi Jinping pointed out that the economy of the Yangtze River Basin is the center and vitality of China's economy. To promote the development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt, we must adhere to ecological priority and green development, place the restoration of the Yangtze River's ecological environment in an overriding position, engage in comprehensive great protection, and refrain from large-scale development. People's courts at all levels must deeply study and comprehend the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech, accurately grasp the strategic positioning and basic connotation of the development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt, regard strengthening environmental resource adjudication work as an important lever for serving and protecting the development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt, promote the continuous improvement of the ecological environment quality in the Yangtze River Basin, and assist the green development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt.

3. Comprehensively strengthening environmental resource adjudication work in the Yangtze River Basin is an objective need to actively respond to the development demands of the Yangtze River Economic Belt and ensure the ecological environmental safety of the basin. The Yangtze River Basin, with water as its link, is rich in environmental elements. It is an important ecological security barrier for China and an important support and foundation for the development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt. The development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt cannot be separated from the guarantee of a sustainable ecological environment and bearable natural resources. People's courts at all levels must always adhere to the basic concept of harmonious coexistence between humans and nature, adhere to the basic state policy of conserving resources and protecting the environment, fully understand the significance of the ecological environmental safety of the Yangtze River Basin for the development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt, lawfully maintain the ecological environmental safety of the Yangtze River Basin, and provide strong judicial protection for building an ecological corridor along the Yangtze River Economic Belt with blue skies, green land, and clean water.

II. Accurately Grasp the Basic Concepts of Comprehensively Strengthening Judicial Protection for Ecological Civilization Construction and Green Development in the Yangtze River Basin

4. Follow the laws of nature. Humans and nature are a community of life. Humans must respect, adapt to, and protect nature. We must correctly understand and grasp the ecological characteristics of the Yangtze River Basin with water as its core, and follow the laws of natural ecology and river evolution. We must follow the natural unity of the basin, coordinate the relationships among rivers and lakes, upper, middle, and lower reaches, main streams and tributaries, left and right banks, and water bodies and shorelines, and protect and improve the ecological service functions of the basin. We must follow the composite nature of the basin's elements, coordinate multiple environmental elements within the entire basin based on environmental resource carrying capacity, existing development intensity, and development potential. We must follow the functional integrity of the basin, maintain the living, production, and ecological functions of the basin, and especially maintain the relative stability and integrity of the basin's ecosystem.

5. Adhere to protection priority. The Yangtze River possesses a unique ecosystem and is an important ecological treasure house for the country. From the overall perspective of economic and social development, we must accurately understand the dialectical relationship between ecological environmental protection and economic and social development, firmly establish and practice the development concept that lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets, adhere to the policy of prioritizing conservation, protection, and natural restoration, and place the protection and restoration of the Yangtze River's ecological environment in the foremost position. Fully leverage the functional role of environmental resource adjudication, protect and improve the water environment, protect and restore water ecology, protect and rationally use water resources, and orderly utilize the Yangtze River shoreline resources.

6. Promote green development. We must accurately grasp the strategic positioning and basic connotation of the development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt, firmly establish and implement the concept of ecological priority and green development. We must fully leverage the functional role of adjudication, implement the requirement to prioritize major ecological restoration projects as options for promoting the development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt, and ensure the smooth implementation of major ecological restoration projects. Centering on the overall requirements of improving the basin's ecological environment, building a three-dimensional transportation corridor, optimizing industrial layout, and constructing a new pattern of opening up, we must provide judicial services and protection for building the Yangtze River Economic Belt into a pioneering demonstration belt for ecological civilization construction, an innovation-driven belt, and a coordinated development belt.

7. Emphasize regional coordination. The linkage and complementarity among rivers and lakes, main streams and tributaries, upper, middle, and lower reaches, and left and right banks in the Yangtze River Basin are strong, and the basin's natural ecosystem characteristics are obvious. We must regard the ecological environmental protection of the Yangtze River Basin as a systematic project, establish the concept of coordinated protection of the ecological environment, and comprehensively promote the systematic management of mountains, waters, forests, farmlands, lakes, and grasslands. We must break down the boundaries and barriers of administrative divisions, promote linkage across the entire basin, construct a new mechanism for regional interactive and cooperative judicial protection, and comprehensively consider the balance of interests among pollution generation areas, pollution prevention and control areas, ecological benefit areas, and ecological protection areas.

III. Based on the Core of the Basin's Water Ecology, Lawfully Adjudicate Water Environment and Water Resources Cases

8. Lawfully adjudicate water pollution prevention and control cases, promote water pollution prevention, control, and treatment. Lawfully adjudicate point source pollution cases such as industrial pollution and ship pollution, non-point source pollution cases such as agricultural pollution and urban runoff pollution, as well as transboundary water pollution cases in the basin. Adhere to the strictest standards for water pollution damage compensation and ecological compensation and restoration. Treat the ecological environment damage and restoration status as an important sentencing circumstance in criminal penalties. Support and supervise administrative authorities in lawfully performing their regulatory responsibilities for water pollution prevention and control. Strengthen the adjudication of water pollution cases arising from the construction and use of navigation and power hubs, ship locks, ports, wharves, and estuaries, ensuring the ecological environmental safety of the main stream and tributaries of the Yangtze River. Strengthen judicial protection for drinking water sources such as the Yangtze River (Jiangdu Water Control Project in Yangzhou) and Danjiangkou Reservoir. Timely accept and adjudicate water pollution cases concerning water source areas. Resolutely support administrative authorities in lawfully shutting down sewage outlets in drinking water source protection areas, ensuring the water quality safety of drinking water sources.

9. Lawfully adjudicate water resource development and utilization cases, promote the sustainable use of Yangtze River water resources. Lawfully adjudicate water diversion dispute cases, properly handle the balance of interests among the water source areas, the areas traversed by water diversion projects, and the water-receiving areas, promoting the safe and smooth regulation and allocation of water resources. Lawfully adjudicate environmental pollution and damage compensation cases arising from the construction of hydropower bases and transmission channels, coordinating the protection of water resource development and utilization rights in upstream areas and the rights to water supply, navigation, irrigation, and aquaculture in downstream areas. Lawfully adjudicate energy dispute cases, supporting the development and utilization of clean energy such as hydropower. Strengthen judicial protection for the energy-saving service industry in the Yangtze River Basin, supporting the cultivation of a contract energy management market across the entire basin.

10. Lawfully adjudicate water rights trading dispute cases, promote the efficient utilization and conservation of water resources. Actively and prudently adjudicate dispute cases involving regional water rights trading, water abstraction rights trading, and irrigation water user water rights trading. Reasonably define the right to use water resources. Guide water rights trading through water rights trading platforms. Fully respect the negotiated pricing or bidding results of the parties to the transaction. Protect the orderly circulation of water use rights.

11. Lawfully adjudicate cases involving navigation channels and river channels, ensure the safety of water transport in the Yangtze River waters. Lawfully combat illegal actions such as encroaching upon or arbitrarily occupying river channels. Restore the ecological functions of river channel water areas and shorelines and the navigation function of river channels. Lawfully combat illegal sand mining in river channels. Fully consider the degree of damage to the ecological environment, punish such acts under the crime of illegal mining. Lawfully adjudicate cases involving violations of the Yangtze River navigation order, damage to navigation channels and navigation facilities. Comprehensively protect the safety of Yangtze River navigation channels. Lawfully adjudicate administrative cases arising from the supervision of navigation channels and river channels. Support and supervise regulatory authorities in lawfully maintaining the order of navigation channels and river channels.

12. Lawfully adjudicate cases involving the protection of river and lake water areas and shorelines, strengthen the ecological functions of river and lake water areas and shorelines. Lawfully combat acts such as illegal land reclamation from lakes and illegal enclosure of river channels for farmland that encroach upon water area space. Protect water ecosystem elements such as river and lake water areas and shoreline resources. Properly adjudicate cases involving water abstraction, sewage discharge, and engineering construction on shorelines. Promote the paid use of shoreline resources. Strengthen the protection and economical intensive use of shorelines. Strengthen judicial protection for scenic spots and natural and cultural landscape resources along the Yangtze River. Promote the rational development of shoreline resources. Maintain the original features of shorelines.

13. Lawfully adjudicate cases involving the development and utilization of flood storage areas and shoals, maintain the safety of flood storage areas and shoals. Properly adjudicate cases involving the development, utilization, construction, and protection of flood storage areas in the basin. Ensure the safety of dikes in flood storage areas and the safety of life and property of the people in flood storage areas. Properly adjudicate cases involving the development, utilization, and protection of basin shoals. Promote the development and utilization of shoals. Maintain the ecological environment of shoals and the safety of life and property of the people.

14. Lawfully adjudicate cases involving river and lake management, promote water resource protection and water pollution control across the entire basin. Lawfully adjudicate criminal cases involving river and lake management. Lawfully combat acts that damage natural rivers, lakes, wetlands, and other water conservation spaces. Lawfully adjudicate civil cases involving river and lake management. Promote water environment protection and water ecological restoration. Protect the water-related rights and interests of the people. Lawfully adjudicate administrative cases and non-litigation administrative enforcement cases involving river and lake management. Promote, regulate, and ensure the implementation of the river chief system. Promote water environment management.

15. Lawfully adjudicate cases involving the Yangtze River protection forest and natural forest and grassland resources, promote soil and water conservation and water conservation on the Yangtze River shorelines. Lawfully combat criminal acts of illegal logging and indiscriminate felling of the Yangtze River protection forest. Maintain the ecological security of the Yangtze River shorelines. Properly adjudicate cases involving forest resource rights confirmation, contracting, and transfer. Lawfully protect the legitimate rights and interests of forest farmers. Ensure the ecological functions of the Yangtze River protection forest, ecological forest, and public welfare forest. Properly adjudicate administrative cases arising from the construction of the Yangtze River protection forest system. Ensure the smooth implementation of the construction of the Yangtze River protection forest system.

16. Lawfully adjudicate cases involving the protection of wetland ecosystems, promote ecological protection and restoration of wetlands. Lawfully combat acts of encroaching upon or destroying wetlands. Strengthen judicial protection for plateau wetland ecosystems. Increase the area and protection rate of natural wetlands. Fully utilize preservation and advance enforcement measures. Increase the responsibility for ecological restoration of damaged wetland environments and natural resources. Make full use of the Yangtze River wetland protection fund. Timely supervise, track, and evaluate the implementation of the obligation to restore the original condition. Properly adjudicate administrative cases arising from the confirmation of wetland resource rights and development permits. Promote ecological protection and restoration of wetlands across the entire basin, including Poyang Lake, Dongting Lake, Taihu Lake, and Chaohu Lake.

17. Lawfully adjudicate other criminal and administrative cases involving water, maintain water environment and water ecological safety. Lawfully adjudicate other criminal cases that harm the water environment and water resources, as well as various administrative cases involving water resource and water environment administrative licensing, planning and project approval, and government information disclosure. Support and supervise administrative authorities in performing their duties lawfully. Promote the rational development, utilization, and protection of water resources. Maintain the water environment and water ecological safety of the basin.

IV. Based on the Ecological and Environmental Characteristics of the Upper, Middle, and Lower Reaches, Lawfully Adjudicate Key Cases in Each Segment

18. People's courts in the upper reaches of the Yangtze River shall focus on the functional positioning of water conservation and soil and water conservation in the upper reaches. Lawfully adjudicate environmental pollution, ecological destruction, and natural resource development and utilization cases in key ecological function areas, fragile ecological environment areas, and nature reserves. Consider the construction of three red lines—the baseline for ecological function protection, the bottom line for environmental quality safety, and the upper limit for natural resource utilization—as important factors.

Lawfully adjudicate environmental pollution and natural resource destruction cases in the Three-River-Source National Park. Resolutely combat illegal activities such as mining, logging, hunting, fishing, soil extraction, water extraction, and unauthorized collection of nationally and provincially key protected wild animals and plants within the Three-River-Source National Park. Promote the long-term conservation and sustainable use of natural resources in the Three-River-Source region. Properly handle disputes arising from the relocation of industrial and mining enterprises and residents in river source areas and ecological core areas. Guide industrial and mining enterprises and residents to relocate in an orderly manner. Properly adjudicate administrative cases arising from the construction of national parks and nature reserves and the implementation of unified environmental access and exit mechanisms. Ensure that key areas achieve the important goal of expanding environmental capacity and ecological space.

Intensify the adjudication of environmental resource cases in the Three Gorges Reservoir area. Actively explore cross-administrative-regional centralized jurisdiction for environmental resource cases in the Three Gorges Reservoir area. Ensure the construction of the Three Gorges Ecological Economic Cooperation Zone. Lawfully adjudicate cases involving soil erosion control and geological disaster prevention in key areas such as the Jinsha River, Wujiang River, Jialing River, and Three Gorges Reservoir area. Protect the safety of life and property of the people.

19. People's courts in the middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze River shall lawfully adjudicate industrial pollution, urban and rural pollution cases. Ensure the ecological environmental safety of rivers and lakes. Lawfully adjudicate industrial pollution cases involving heavy chemical industries, heavy metals, and industrial solid waste in the urban agglomerations of the middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze River. Ensure timely case filing, adjudication, and enforcement. Make full use of preservation measures to avoid irreversible damage. Properly adjudicate administrative cases arising from the closure, relocation, or transformation of enterprises that seriously pollute water bodies, such as papermaking, printing and dyeing, chemical, and non-ferrous metal industries, as well as cases arising from the collection of fees such as sewage treatment fees and water resource fees. Promote pollution control compliance or lawful withdrawal of polluting enterprises.

Lawfully adjudicate cases involving urban sewage and garbage treatment. Promote the comprehensive collection and treatment of sewage and garbage in cities and towns along the main stream and tributaries of the Yangtze River. Lawfully adjudicate cases involving pollutant discharge from rural agricultural livestock, poultry, and aquaculture, as well as rural domestic waste discharge. Prevent agricultural non-point source pollution. Promote comprehensive improvement of the rural human settlement environment. Prevent rural water source pollution. Lawfully adjudicate soil pollution cases arising from industrial and agricultural production. Prevent toxic and hazardous pollutants, dangerous chemicals, and hazardous waste from entering the Yangtze River water body through the groundwater circulation system.

Strengthen judicial protection for water pollution prevention and control in freshwater lakes such as Dongting Lake, Poyang Lake, Taihu Lake, and Chaohu Lake. Lawfully combat acts that damage the ecological environment of freshwater lakes. Strengthen judicial protection for the Poyang Lake and Dongting Lake Ecological Economic Zones. Ensure the construction of the Poyang Lake and Dongting Lake Ecological Economic Zones. Strengthen the protection of fishery resources in the basin. Lawfully combat acts of fishing for aquatic products in prohibited fishing areas, during prohibited fishing seasons, or using prohibited tools or methods. Properly adjudicate cases involving fishery contracting, aquaculture, and sales. Promote the sustainable use of fishery resources.

20. Maritime courts along the Yangtze River shall make full use of their advantage of cross-administrative-regional jurisdiction. Properly adjudicate environmental pollution and ecological destruction cases in the Yangtze River Basin. Lawfully adjudicate cases of ship collisions and contacts in the Yangtze River waters. Strengthen the adjudication of cases involving water pollution caused by the discharge, leakage, or dumping of oil, sewage, or other harmful substances from ships. Protect the ecological environmental safety of the Yangtze River waters.

V. Based on Green Development Requirements, Lawfully Adjudicate Other Environmental Resource Cases

21. Lawfully adjudicate air pollution prevention and control cases. Focus on the comprehensive prevention and control of major air pollutants such as sulfur dioxide, nitrogen oxides, and PM2.5. Lawfully punish criminal acts that pollute the environment. Properly adjudicate relevant administrative cases. Support and supervise administrative authorities in performing their duties of source control and full-process management. Promote the reversal of regional haze and acid rain situations in the Sichuan Basin and the middle and lower reaches. Promote the improvement of air quality in cities along the Yangtze River and key areas. Win the battle for blue skies.

22. Lawfully adjudicate biodiversity protection cases. Lawfully combat illegal hunting, killing of precious and endangered wild animals, illegal hunting, and illegal trade in wild animal and plant products. Strengthen the protection of endemic endangered wild animals and plants in the Yangtze River Basin, such as giant pandas, yew trees, and Chinese alligators. Properly adjudicate cases involving new plant varieties, biological genetic resources, and genes. Effectively protect the biological gene resource bank of the Yangtze River Basin. Strengthen the protection of Yangtze River species and their habitats and breeding grounds. Properly adjudicate cases of damage to aquatic and riparian biodiversity and species habitats caused by industrial pollution. Lawfully combat the act of smuggling animals and plants the importation of which is prohibited by the state. Strictly prevent the invasion of alien species.

23. Lawfully adjudicate environmental public interest litigation cases and ecological environmental damage compensation litigation cases filed by provincial governments. Lawfully accept and adjudicate environmental civil public interest litigation cases filed by social organizations and environmental administrative and civil public interest litigation cases filed by the procuratorial authorities. Strengthen public participation in the ecological environmental protection of the Yangtze River Basin. Fully implement the concept of restoration and compensation mechanism. Form the functions of evaluation guidance and policy formation of public interest litigation for the ecological environmental protection of the Yangtze River Basin. Effectively maintain the ecological environmental safety of the Yangtze River Basin. Promote the establishment of a system for the management and use of special funds for environmental public interest litigation in the Yangtze River Basin. Ensure the healthy development of environmental public interest litigation in the Yangtze River Basin. Summarize the adjudication experience of pilot areas in the Yangtze River Basin. Lawfully adjudicate ecological environmental damage compensation litigation cases filed by provincial governments. Lawfully pursue the ecological environmental damage compensation liability of responsible entities.

24. Actively and prudently adjudicate ecological compensation cases. Scientifically define the rights and obligations of ecological protectors and beneficiaries. Promote the formation of a working mechanism for ecological damage compensation, beneficiary payment, and reasonable compensation for protectors. Properly handle disputes arising from compensation subjects, compensation amounts, and fund supervision within the basin. Stimulate the internal motivation for ecological environmental protection in each segment of the entire basin. Promote the establishment of an independent and impartial ecological environmental damage assessment system.

25. Actively and prudently adjudicate new types of cases such as green finance. Deeply study the special legal issues in the development of green finance. Properly adjudicate new types of cases involving green credit, green bonds, green development funds, green insurance, and carbon finance. Support the development of green industries. Ensure the construction of the green financial system. Lawfully protect the rights to use, transfer, and mortgage pollution emission rights obtained for value. Fully utilize the carbon emission rights trading registration and recording system to accurately determine the subject of emission allowances. Reasonably determine the rights and obligations of the parties to the transaction. Lawfully protect the act of trading energy consumption rights indicators by trading entities in legitimate trading venues. Reference the trading management measures, trading rules, and dispute resolution mechanisms formulated in pilot areas. Properly adjudicate energy consumption rights dispute cases.

26. Lawfully handle environmental administrative non-litigation enforcement cases. Actively explore new methods and new ideas for the enforcement of administrative non-litigation cases that meet the needs of ecological civilization construction and green development in the Yangtze River Basin. Lawfully review environmental administrative non-litigation enforcement cases. In accordance with the model of "separation of adjudication and enforcement", strengthen the enforcement of environmental administrative non-litigation cases. Support administrative authorities in lawfully punishing environmental illegal acts.

VI. Improve Systems and Mechanisms to Meet New Requirements for Judicial Protection of Ecological Civilization and Green Development in the Yangtze River Basin

27. Optimize trial mechanisms. Advance the centralized jurisdiction mechanism for environmental public interest litigation, cross-administrative region environmental pollution, and ecological damage cases within the basin. Advance the "three-in-one" or "two-in-one" centralized adjudication model for criminal, civil, and administrative environmental resource cases within the basin. Advance the construction of a specialized jurisdiction mechanism for major environmental resource administrative cases to be tried in cross-administrative region courts.

28. Build synergy mechanisms. Build a collaborative trial mechanism among criminal, civil, and administrative trial divisions, as well as case filing and enforcement departments. Build a Yangtze River Basin environmental resource trial cooperation platform, forming mechanisms across basin courts for entrusted service, entrusted evidence collection, entrusted enforcement, and information sharing. Build an information reporting mechanism between higher and lower courts within the region.

29. Improve coordination mechanisms. Strengthen coordination and linkage with government legal affairs departments, administrative law enforcement agencies, and basin management institutions within the region, actively build an environmental resource information sharing platform for the Yangtze River Basin. Through establishing and improving coordination mechanisms such as information sharing, joint meetings, and emergency response to sudden environmental incidents, form a joint force to jointly safeguard the ecological security of the Yangtze River Economic Belt.

December 1, 2017
